title: Bobkov functional in dimension zero
statement: For every real-valued function $f$ on the zero-dimensional Boolean cube, $B(f)=\overline I(\mathbb E f)$, where $\overline I$ is the closed Gaussian profile and the expectation is under the uniform measure on that cube.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued function on the zero-dimensional Boolean cube
replaced: For a real function $f$ on the uniform Boolean cube $\{0,1\}^n$, write $D_i f(x)=(f(x^{i\leftarrow0})-f(x^{i\leftarrow1}))/2$ and $B(f)=\mathbb E\sqrt{\overline I(f)^2+\sum_i(D_i f)^2}$, where $\overline I$ is the Gaussian profile extended by zero outside $(0,1)$. In dimension $n=0$, $B(f)=\overline I(\mathbb E f)$.
